LOW_UTILIZATION.label: Low fund utilization
LOW_UTILIZATION.detail: Less than 50% of sanctioned funds spent despite the work not being marked Completed.

COST_INFLATION.label: Cost far above category norm
COST_INFLATION.detail: Sanctioned cost is more than double the median cost for this work category.

EXCESS_DELAY.label: Abnormally long completion time
EXCESS_DELAY.detail: Took more than 2x the typical completion time for this category.

AGENCY_CONCENTRATION.label: Single agency dominance
AGENCY_CONCENTRATION.detail: One implementing agency handles an unusually high share of this MP's works.

DUPLICATE_DESCRIPTION.label: Near-duplicate / vague description
DUPLICATE_DESCRIPTION.detail: Work description is near-identical to another work, or generically vague, hindering verification.

ROUND_NUMBER_COST.label: Suspiciously round sanctioned amount
ROUND_NUMBER_COST.detail: Cost sanctioned is an unusually round figure (e.g. exact multiple of ₹10,000), atypical for itemised estimates.

YEAR_END_RUSH.label: Year-end rush sanction
YEAR_END_RUSH.detail: Sanctioned in Jan-Mar, consistent with 'use-it-or-lose-it' spending pressure rather than planned need.

WORK_SPLITTING.label: Possible work-splitting
WORK_SPLITTING.detail: Cost sits just under a scrutiny threshold and matches other same-day, same-agency sanctions — a known tactic to avoid higher approval levels.

SHELL_AGENCY_PATTERN.label: Agency operates across distant MPs with high flag rate
SHELL_AGENCY_PATTERN.detail: This implementing agency has an unusually high flag rate across many different MPs/districts, atypical for a genuine local contractor.

STALLED_STATUS.label: Stalled after partial payment
STALLED_STATUS.detail: Substantial funds released but work is stalled or not started — a common precursor to fund misappropriation.

STATISTICAL_ANOMALY.label: Multivariate statistical anomaly
STATISTICAL_ANOMALY.detail: Isolation Forest flagged this work's overall feature combination as an outlier, even where no single rule crosses its threshold.

CROSS_SCHEME_DUPLICATE.label: Possible cross-scheme duplicate funding
CROSS_SCHEME_DUPLICATE.detail: A matching asset (same district, category and near-identical cost within an overlapping sanction window) also appears in a synthetic MGNREGS / state-scheme feed — consistent with the same physical asset being billed twice across schemes.
